h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Muzaffarnagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Muzaffarnagar

items.pText: Muzaffarnagar sits in the sugarcane belt of western Uttar Pradesh, and many schools here, in town and in the surrounding villages, have large open grounds. Space is rarely the problem. The challenge is placing equipment sensibly on a big field shared with cricket, assemblies and sometimes stray animals. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,220 km away, and delivers it by road.

Share a photo of your whole ground, its rough measurements and how it is used through the day. We will suggest where the play area should go, what equipment suits your students and how much safe play area each piece needs, all marked on a layout drawing. Our team or a dealer in north India installs once you approve.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Placing a playground on a large school ground

c: Put the play area near the classrooms used by younger students, so teachers can watch it and small children do not cross the whole field. Keep it well away from the cricket pitch, where hard balls fly. A low fence around the play area keeps animals out and marks the zone clearly.

items.q: Where should the playground go on a big school ground?
items.a: Near the classrooms of younger students, away from the cricket pitch, with a low fence around it. We can suggest a position if you send a photo of the whole ground.

items.q: Do you supply village schools near Muzaffarnagar?
items.a: Yes. We deliver anywhere reachable by road and install with our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing.

items.q: Is a fence needed around the play area?
items.a: It is a good idea on open grounds. A low fence keeps stray animals out, marks the safe zone and helps teachers supervise.
